title: leave_organization: no predicate root carries "the caller is this organisation's only owner", so the platform action cannot be disabled for the last owner before the click (better-auth refuses it only after the confirm)
body:
Ruled: 6228318638 · letter B′ on #24034 (batch #358 item 3) · 2026-10-17T02:11Z
Re-scoped by the ruling: no predicate root. `sys_organization` declares a roll-up `owner_count` (`summary` over `sys_member`, `function: 'count'`, filter role contains owner) and `leave_organization` declares `disabled: "'org_owner' in current_user.positions && record.owner_count == 1"`; the reason text stays the console's generic one until a reason key exists. First step: measure that the roll-up is maintained for `sys_member` rows better-auth writes; if not, this card closes `not_planned` (the server's refusal stays the guard). `pm:on-hold` → `pm:queue` + `pm:retriage` in this act.

Filing gate: **(b) a named producer is blocked by it.** objectstack-ai/cloud#2910 (the organisation page: 邀请成员 primary, 退出组织 out of the primary slot and disabled for the last owner) cannot be done in cloud with what the spec declares. The os-dev on that card measured each gap with contract probes at framework `f7e836da` / objectui `ef71a09f` (report on cloud#2910). Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6026, session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`). ⛔ Not a claim.
Dedupe: no open objectstack issue names an only-owner or sole-owner predicate.

## The gap
- **The console's predicate roots:** its `current_user` carries id, email, name, positions, isPlatformAdmin and `can()` (objectui `app-shell/src/providers/expressionUser.ts` L163, L182). A `sys_organization` row carries no owner count.
- **The server side already refuses:** better-auth 1.7.3 `organization/leave` refuses the only owner with `YOU_CANNOT_LEAVE_THE_ORGANIZATION_AS_THE_ONLY_OWNER` (`crud-members.mjs` L427). So the cost today is a refused click after a confirm. No membership is lost.
- `leave_organization` (`platform-objects/src/identity/sys-organization.object.ts` L140–157) declares no `disabled`.

## Done when
A declared fact that `disabled` can read, such as the caller's role in the organisation and the organisation's owner count, and `leave_organization` declaring `disabled` on it. Its reason is #24018's key (the spec's disabled-reason key).
